nameEn: Manufacture of pharmaceuticals, medicinal chemical and botanical products
description: This class includes the manufacture of pharmaceuticals, medicinal chemical and botanical products for human or veterinary use.
includes: manufacture of medicinal active substances to be used for their pharmacological properties in the manufacture of medicaments: antibiotics, basic vitamins, salicylic and O-acetylsalicylic acids etc.
manufacture of medicaments: manufacture of a wide range of goods such as antisera and other blood fractions, vaccines, diverse medicaments including homeopathic preparations
manufacture of medical diagnostic preparations, including pregnancy tests
manufacture of radioactive in-vivo diagnostic substances
manufacture of chemical contraceptive products for external use and hormonal contraceptives
manufacture of medical impregnated wadding, gauze, bandages, dressings etc.
manufacture of pharmaceutical preparations for veterinary use
manufacture of plasters, pads and similar articles
excludes: manufacture of soaps, soap-based products and detergents, see 2023
manufacture of medical furniture and instruments, see 3250
wholesale of pharmaceuticals and medical goods, see 4649
